nodes.label: Next.js Starter Template Asset Set
nodes.rationale: next.svg, vercel.svg, file.svg, globe.svg and window.svg are the untouched create-next-app scaffold assets: identical 16x16 viewBoxes, the same #666 monochrome fill, and brand marks for the framework and its host. They are unrelated to ASV telemetry and are dead weight left behind by the template; no source file references them (only /ping.svg is wired into MapLeaflet). Kept only because deleting scaffold assets is cosmetic and risks breaking the default landing page.
